svg.title: 台北五大夜市與捷運位置示意圖 / Five Taipei night markets on the MRT
svg.desc: 簡化的台北捷運圖：淡水信義線（紅）由士林、劍潭往南經雙連、中山、台北車站到中正紀念堂，再往東到信義安和與台北101／世貿；松山新店線（綠）由松山往西到中山，再經西門到中正紀念堂；板南線（藍）經西門與台北車站。士林夜市在劍潭站，營業 17:00–24:00；寧夏夜市從雙連站 1 號出口步行約 10 分、中山站 5 號出口約 8 分，18:00–24:00；饒河街觀光夜市從松山站 1、2、5 號出口步行約 3 分，全長約 600 公尺，17:00–24:00；臨江街觀光夜市（通化街夜市）從信義安和站 4 號出口步行約 10 分、六張犁站約 15 分，18:00–24:00；南機場夜市沒有捷運站，從中正紀念堂站步行約 20 分、西門站約 25 分，或搭公車到南機場公寓站，許可時段 05:00–24:00，各攤營業時間不同。時間為臺北市市場處與臺北捷運公司公告，2026 年 9 月查證。A simplified Taipei MRT map. The red Tamsui-Xinyi Line runs from Shilin and Jiantan south through Shuanglian, Zhongshan and Taipei Main Station to Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, then east to Xinyi Anhe and Taipei 101/World Trade Center; the green Songshan-Xindian Line runs from Songshan west to Zhongshan, then via Ximen to Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall; the blue Bannan Line passes Ximen and Taipei Main Station. Shilin Night Market: Jiantan station, 17:00 to 24:00. Ningxia: about 10 minutes from Shuanglian exit 1 or 8 minutes from Zhongshan exit 5, 18:00 to 24:00. Raohe Street: about 3 minutes from Songshan exits 1, 2 or 5, one lane of about 600 m, 17:00 to 24:00. Linjiang Street (Tonghua): about 10 minutes from Xinyi Anhe exit 4 or 15 minutes from Liuzhangli, 18:00 to 24:00. Nanjichang: no MRT station, about 20 minutes on foot from Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall or 25 from Ximen, or a bus to the Nanjichang Apartments stop; licensed 05:00 to 24:00, stall hours vary. Times from the Taipei City Market Administration Office and Taipei Metro, checked September 2026.
